note: Lake Skinner Recreation Area, a Riverside County regional park on a Metropolitan Water District reservoir: no swimming or other body contact, boats need an inspection decal, and dogs stay 50 ft from the high-water mark. The three loops sit on open ground above the north shore; none of the sites is close to the lake, and Campground B's southern rows (sites 277-298) are nearest, looking over scrub to the water. A splash pad runs April to Labor Day. --Claude
